meta.title: 高肘抱水 光研究角度有什么用
meta.title_en: High-Elbow Catch — What's the Point of Angle Theory Alone?

scenes.title_en: The Point: Angle Theory Alone Is Useless
scenes.context: 高肘抱水，光研究角度没用。关键是抱水要从头前开始，而不是从身体侧面。语域：游泳教学，问题引入。
sentences: 高肘抱水，光研究角度没用。
For the high-elbow catch, angle theory alone is useless.
The catch starts ahead of your head.
Not from the side of your body.
paraphrase: 高肘抱水 → high-elbow catch / elbow-up pull
头前 → ahead of the head / in front
ahead of the head · in front
scenes.speak: For the high-elbow catch, angle theory alone is useless. The catch starts ahead of your head. Not from the side of your body.

scenes.context: 学员做高肘抱水，教练指出动作起始点过晚。教练问：我高肘了？学员也是抱水——但这里也太晚了。语域：游泳教学，纠错对话。
sentences: 教练：我高肘了，也是抱水。
But starting here is way too late.
The catch should start further forward.
paraphrase: 起始点 → starting point / where the catch begins
太晚 → way too late / far too delayed
scenes.speak: Coach: “I'm elbow-up, catching too.” But starting here is way too late. The catch should start further forward.

scenes.context: 教练示范正确动作：从头前开始抱水并保持水感。从头前抱着水过来，手掌和前臂才有水可抓。语域：游泳教学，正确示范。
sentences: The coach demos: start in front of the head.
Carry the water as you pull through.
Keep the feel of the water the whole way.
paraphrase: 水感 → feel of the water / water pressure
feel of the water · water pressure
scenes.speak: The coach demos: start in front of the head. Carry the water as you pull through. Keep the feel of the water the whole way.

scenes.title_en: The Key: Elbow-Up AND a Catch
scenes.context: 只做了高肘的动作，但抱水没了，那只是摆姿势。高肘与抱水要同时成立。语域：游泳教学，要领总结。
sentences: 只做高肘动作，抱水就没了。
Only the elbow-up pose, and the catch disappears.
高肘和抱水要同时成立。
Elbow-up and the catch must work together.
paraphrase: 摆姿势 → striking a pose / just for show
striking a pose · just for show
同时成立 → work together / both matter
scenes.speak: Only the elbow-up pose, and the catch disappears. That's just striking a pose. Elbow-up and the catch must work together.

practice: The catch starts ahead of your head.
Starting here is way too late.
Carry the water as you pull through.
Elbow-up and the catch must work together.
pitfalls: 「光研究角度」用 angle theory alone。
The catch starts ahead of your head.
「抱水从头前开始」，不是身体侧面。
Only the elbow-up pose, and the catch disappears.
「只做高肘」没抱水，等于摆姿势。
Starting here is way too late.
shifts: 用 high-elbow catch（高肘抱水）、elbow-up（高肘）、catch（抱水）
用 striking a pose（摆姿势）、start in front（从头前开始）、way too late（太晚）
用 angle theory（角度理论）、feel of the water（水感）、carry the water（抱着水）
footer_notes: 转录为低质量 ASR（“高手”实为“高肘”），结合图文实录图片说明重建。已校正：高肘抱水、光研究角度没用、从头前开始、不是身体侧面、起始点过晚、抱着水过来、保持水感、只做高肘动作抱水没了、摆姿势、同时成立等。
